tiers.name: Free
tiers.who_its_for: Solo devs evaluating or running personal projects
tiers.rationale: 30s free interval beats UptimeRobot Free (5-min) and Better Stack Free (no interval stated); strong acquisition hook.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.who_its_for: Indie devs and solo platform engineers running production
tiers.rationale: Priced above UptimeRobot Solo ($12) to reflect 30s interval and API-first value; well below Better Stack ($29).

tiers.name: Team
tiers.rationale: Matches UptimeRobot Team ($39) on seats but doubles monitor count; undercuts Better Stack per-seat model for small teams.

recommendation.positioning_note: Current $10/mo team plan is underpriced vs Better Stack ($29) and leaves margin on the table given the Terraform differentiator.
risks: Free tier with 30s intervals may cannibalize Pro conversions if limits feel generous enough for most indie devs
$19 Pro sits in a crowded $12-$29 band; Terraform differentiator must be prominent in messaging to justify the premium over UptimeRobot
Uptime Kuma (free self-hosted) is the real zero-cost alternative; price must stay below the hosting cost of self-managing Kuma

confidence.notes: 3 established competitors confirmed with scraped pricing (UptimeRobot, Better Stack, Uptime.com). Pingdom pricing page rendered navigation only — no tier prices extracted; excluded from anchor. Uptime Kuma is open-source with no commercial pricing page, marked niche. Confidence docked slightly because Pingdom tiers could not be confirmed from scrape.
